nom: Hero Cosmetics Pore Release Blackhead Solution

avis.texte: I saw so many great reviews and bought because of the glass packaging to reduce plastic waste and because it had two actives that each on their own is useful for my skin. but for some reason this just didn't work for my skin type. it makes me get raging inflamed and deep pustules. i tried to use it for a couple to a few months to see if i just needed to get past the purging period but just can't deal with it anymore so im giving it away to someone who it might work for. sad because its so hard to find a product that meets the wishlist but glad it still works for some people
shockingly effective at drawing gunk out of the pores. this is a new staple item for my skin

Two weeks using this product morning and night every other day has done more for me than years of using a very expensive product. I splash it directly on my skin and pat it in with my fingertips. My pores look teenaged again! Worth EVERY penny.
Hero is a really good product for blurring and minimizing pores.

I've bought this multiple times now. Luckily, it usually goes on sale at Ulta at least once a year, so I stock up. It's gentle as can be but has really made a difference in the appearance of the pores on my nose. And I don't break out along my jawline like I used to regularly. Highly recommend! And I'm an old lady with mature drying skin.

avis.titre: Ok product but not for sensitive dry skin
avis.texte: I tried to use this product multiple times while is did clear my black heads it made my skin itchy and very reactive. I didnt use it often i tried once a week and even then my face would have a bad reaction to this product and mess up my skin barrier so I would not recommend if you have very dry sensitive skin.

At 37 yo i have hormonal acne that consists of many blackheads & clogged pores along my jawline, chin and neck area. I bought this in hopes that it would help the amount of blackheads I get. Unfortunately, I found that this product didnt work better than any other salicylic acid based toners on the market. And believe me, ive tried LOTS. Lets just say I went from regular member status to diamond in 2 months, if that's any indication on how much money ive spent trying different products for my acne sitch lol. So far the best thing thats worked for my blackheads is the Peach Slices exfoliating acne toner and the Good Molecules overnight exfoliating treatment (used together) and you can get both of those for less than this Hero toner costs.

avis.titre: Clogged pores yes, full on blackheads no good
avis.texte: I have some bad blackheads that it did nothing for. However my stomach area has really bad clogged pores due to me being overweight. It has helped PREVENT bad blemishes there! Although it does not clean out or dissolve anything. Still happy it helps

This product has only a 3-4 months on it. As I don't anticipate to use 1mL per day, I expect this will expire long before the bottle is empty. Dissapointing. Other than that, it hasn't irritated my skin which is nice as some similar products can and have.

I have blackheads on my nose that i want to get rid of and I really wanted this product to work for me but unfortunately it not only made the blackheads on my nose more pigmented/noticeable, even more started popping up and spreading on parts of my nose that didn't have them before. Also my nose can get pretty oily especially over the summer but for some reason this made my nose wetter than the ocean lol… i dont have sensitive skin and I've never had a bad reaction to the many skincare products that I've tried over the years so I'm not sure what the real issue was. I used the product 2/3 times a week for 2 weeks.
Using this after Pore-fessionals clay mask and ove finally found a combination that works! I can only use it twice a week or my skin will get very scaley
I loved this toner. It doesn't completely clean out my pores (i do it like the instructions) but i do notice it shrinks my pores.
I loved this toner. It doesn't completely clean out my pores (i do it like the instructions) but i do notice it shrinks my pores.

I bought this thinking this would be another one of those products that says that it unclogs your pores and then didn't work but it actually did! I pleasantly surprised! My pores look smaller and clean! Only bad thing is it takes more than one use for it to work and it might sting a little bit, but I use the elf thirst burst drops or the milk blue cooling stick after it and it doesn't sting at all. Highly recomend! I love this!

i bought and used this for the first time last night. i am not one to add products often, as i am cautious with adding new things to my routine. i applied this lightly with a cotton pad on areas with one or two black heads. i woke up the next morning and those spots with one or two black heads became flooded with blackheads packed next to eachother wherever the product touched. the skin is also inflamed and painful. my skin has actually never looked worse than now after ONLY ONE USE. i have very very mild acne and this is a huge set back for the health of my skin.

It works! I recommend using a cotton pad to gently push the product into the areas where your pores are and rub gently. I rub in circles for about five seconds in the affected areas. In four days, I've noticed my pores appear smaller and they are unclogged. I've used this to unclog pools on my body, my chest for instance when I get chest acne. It actually unclogged and actually works. I'm definitely buying another bottle! The bottle is made of glass so be careful.

My pores shrank after 4 days of using. Its actually been working… you can feel your skin tingle/tighten slightly where your pores are then your skin feels so soft and clean after…. It actually unclogs pores. I used it one a body pore.. an ingrown hair bump and it actually helped the gunk come iug and shrink the bump.. i hope they make a body toner version of this. The smell may turn some peope off but ive always loved the smell of toners.
I was very disapointed in this , i was so excited to get it , used for months & it did not get rid of not one blackhead , im in my 60's

This stuff works!!! I've struggled with black heads since puberty and have even been made fun of for them. This cleared 95% of them up. It works even better if you use a black head mask or pore strip.
I love this. Ive tried plenty of products for my blackheads and this one is by far the best one. I recommend it

this helped clear up any congestion or bumps that i had on my face but i did not see a difference on my nose (which is why i bought it) it would also pill underneath my makeup so i just ended up using it as my nighttime skincare
If used daily, there's a noticeable difference in the prominence of the blackheads on my nose. Worth the price.
I have been dealing with clogged pores my entire adult life and this is the first product that has made a difference

This product is amazing! I have major trouble with clogged pores/blackheads on my nose and either side of my nose. I have tried so many things, and nothing has ever removed the clogs. There was a noticeable difference after 1 use. All the blackheads on my cheeks are completely gone. I've used 3 times and the blackheads on my nose are almost completely gone, and hugely improved. I'm just shocked this is actually working and so quickly! Its also reducing the appearance/size of pores dramatically. So happy with this!

I really like this a lot. This combined with double cleansing has really helped the appearance of my pores on my nose and cheeks. I have enlarged pores with some scarring and lots of blackheads so this has been amazing for helping clean my face. I only use it at night after washing all my makeup off but it has visibly changed how my skin looks. I really love this product and in general have been really happy with all the purchases I've made from this brand overall.

This stuff works great for me. I don't have a lot of issues with breakouts, but I do get small black heads on my nose and chest. I can see a considerable difference in using this just one time. It doesn't burn like a lot of acne medications either.

I bought this for my 16 year old daughter at her request. She has struggled with blackheads for several years and bumps that are white underneath but havent reached a head. She has been using this for a week now and her face has cleared up by over 75%! Most of the blackheads and bumps are gone and the ones that are still there are greatly reduced in size. She is so happy!

I had high hopes when I bought this, but sadly I saw no improvements in the size or look of my poors and my blackheads did not improve at all. I used the product every other evening until I finished the bottle.
I used this product consistenly for a month and ended up with even bigger/more blackheads than before. It could just be my skin type, but this product was an absolute waste of money.

Sadly, I really wanted this product to work because I Love this brand. It made my face extra oily and It didn't help my black heads at all. not even a little bit. maybe even made my skin worse by making it oily the next morning. The only good thing I have to say is that it didn't Burn my face and it didn't hurt if you put it near a open cut or sore.

avis.titre: Not sure what the hype is about?
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this since it had really good reviews! It did nothing for my pores or blackheads. It doesnt have a smell nor did I feel any tingles on my face. Almost like it was just water. I wonder if it was old? Going back to Dime toner.
My forehead broke out all over in acne from steriods I had to take when I was sick. I applied this product about 5 times in the past week and my skin is completely clear!
This product made no difference for my skin. I have oily, acne prone skin. I tried using it for a few weeks. Two stars because it didn't cause irritation; it simply didn't do anything.
So far this has gotten rid of most of my forehead and chin congestion

I purchased this for my husband who had larger pores and blackheads. Within three days of use, he was noticing a difference. After a week of use, I notice a significant difference. This is going to be a product that I will buy again and again for him.

This is my second bottle. I just finished the first one after having it for MONTHS. It lasts a very long time. I even put it in a spray bottle and use 6 sprays every night and it still lasted forever. I have very oily skin and this product has helped with the oil production. My skin is still oily but the morning after using this I can always tell the difference.
Ive used this product 4 days and it works! No dryness or irritation.
I've been using this for a couple weeks and haven't had any results. I use it 2-3 times per day.

This is the first exfoliating toner I have introduced to my skincare- I wanted this product to tighten and clear my pores. Ive been using only twice a week after cleansing and using a hyaluronic acid, applying to a completely DRY face with a cotton round and layering my moisturizer over it. I have seen NOTICEABLE difference in my pores after just 3 uses. Not only that, I am combo, acne prone skin and this has not broken me out at all but has actually helped my active pimples & completely got rid of incoming ones. This product (if you struggle with acne, texture, or enlarged pores) is absolutely worth a try for the price. I will likely repurchase this over and over.

avis.titre: This actually works for my nose
avis.texte: I have had these small tiny blackheads on my nose for as lonf as I can remember. Nothing could get rid of them. I wash my face and take care of my skin, but these things just wouldnt go away. So i thought i juat had to live with them. I was searching ulta for pore and blackhead treatment and found rhis product. I havw used it 3 to 4 times now and am noticing a hude difference. My pores just look clean and smaller. I gave 4 stars for now because im new to it. But im excited to see how my skin looks a few weeks from now.
i only used it a coupke times but definitely reducded my pores / blach heads!

At first, the product was working and once I started to use it everyday it was fine until it wasn't. I stopped using it for a day and I woke up with little tiny bumps all over my face. I was shocked. Luckily I know how to get rid of them but I'm frustrated.
I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! It has helped me eliminate my blackheads. But can also be harmful to sensitive skin.

Cleared and smoothed my skin. I used a lotion that clogged my pores and gave me blackheads and this high percentage serum is working really well to clear up my skin and bring it back to normal health and function!
Great Daily toner that reduces blackheads and normalize sebum production. Highly recommend for t zone / combo skin.

I'm loving this pore cleanser solution! I've tried just about everything. I really like how deep this gets without so much work and it's so crazy abrasive. My nose and pores on my cheeks look so much better. My skin still feels hydrated and it's not left feeling dry. Definitely happy with this!

avis.titre: this toner + double cleanse = no more blackheads
avis.texte: This toner is exceptionally good, even on sensitive skin. I make sure to double cleanse with an oil then water based cleanser to extract any sebaceous filaments, and this toner is the only thing that has drastically reduced how much they come back.
It's been great for my pores. They are finally shrinking and my face feels so clean. I would recommend.
Great product. Doesn't dry my sensitive skin. Leaves me with a glow
I used this product everyday for about a month on my nose and didn't see any improvement in reduced blackheads. I don't recommend.
Love this product. Keeps my pores nice and clear without over drying or irritating my skin :+1:
I saw results immediately after the first few days of applying it to my blackheads areas.
I was really impressed with how well this works for my pores. I can tell a difference when I am using it.
I noticed a decrease in pore size right away. Love this product.

I will update this review after I've used this product longer. So far I've used it about 6 times. I haven't seen any improvement but have been disappointed as my skin is sticky and uncomfortable after use. I've tried using less product and putting on a very thin layer, but my skin is always sticky. I can feel the product sitting on my skin for a while too…it doesn't ever soak in. Would not ourchase again.
This is great replacement for other products available. It actually combats your pores without including several irritating ingredients.
This seems to be working for me! It helps the Hero patches do a better job at removing the black heads from my nose.

This works great on my oily skin. Even after cleansing with makeup remover wipes and facial soap it still is never enough for my super oily skin. I use this after to get the extra clean and to help keep my skin clear of any acne. Gentle on skin.
It's a good product I've reordered it doesn't dry out my skin and it's not a harsh product
Amazing toner! I use it daily and have gotten great results. A little bit watery but fantastic ingredients.
It really has cleared up my pores and rates very well on the Yuka app.

During the summer my skin does tend to see some blackheads that I usually do not deal with. So I turned to this solution and am happy I did. The release was very quick, much quicker than products I have used in the past. Definitely recommend for anyone with problematic blackheads!
This has continued to keep my pores unclogged without making my face feel raw. The packaging is fancy yet portable. Many of Heros products are great for on the go!
I love this product! Has definitely helped my skin immensely. My pores appear clearer and don't get as clogged as they used to!
I started using this almost 6 months ago I think. The bottles last me a very long time and my skin always feels super smooth and glows after!
It took a few weeks but I can really tell a difference in my problem areas. I'm very happy with Pore Release!

Purchased this product twice already. Everyone has pores and you can't "get rid" of them. That said, this worked wonders for me. I purchased this with my nose area in mind but this made a huge difference on my entire face. Noticed a change in the appearance of my pores the first week of using.
Works really well and I've seen a cumulative difference and marked improvement in my complexion over the last few weeks. Not too drying and didn't cause any irritation.

I tried this on a whim&was quickly obsessed! I've struggled with blackheads, clogged pores&bumps my whole life. I'm almost 50 and tried tons of products. THIS. STUFF. WORKS. I'm so pleasantly impressed and happy. It did not dry my skin even using it a few times a day. The results were fast! Even other's at work noticed a change in my skin. I use the cleanser and then this. Excellent product, stocking up!

I'm 77 years old with pretty dry skin and large pores on my nose that never look clean. This product is my hero! I've been using Hero for about 10 days now after washing my face at night. The change is remarkable! I only use it on and around my nose and the pores are now nearly invisible. So happy.

As someone who struggles with sensitive skin, I always get worried with something that has SA in it. This product never caused an issue for me though. It made my skin look and feel like glass, my redness went down so much and my blackheads are almost non existing. I recommend this to all of my sensitive skin girls and guys out there and anyone struggling with some bumps on their skin and forests of blackheads. This product will change your life!

I've struggled with blackheads my whole life. My WHOLE life. My mom would pick at my blackheads when I was a baby. This stuff works. It really does. The week I got it I used it once a day (at night) and I saw a difference after a week. I dropped down to every other night the next week. And since then I use it twice a week. My blackheads are mostly gone. This is crazy to me!
Has an interesting smell but after a couple weeks my skin is getting clearer and pores are clearer. Very light weight.

avis.titre: good, though a tad drying for already dry skin!
avis.texte: effective! use according to the instructions-- applying 2-3x a week until you're satisfied, and then only applying once a week. Personally I am a bit forgetful, so I restart this a lot, and what I find is that after the first 2-3 initial uses, the skin on my nose starts peeling. My skin adjusts to the product with heavier moisturizing and time. If you are also a forgetful person with dry-er skin, be gentle + use moisturizer + set reminders on your phone so you keep on schedule.
Using this twice a day has really improved my skin. I also like the fact that it has a combination of alpha hydroxy as well as salicylic acid.

Amazing! I have been fighting blackheads for most of my adult life, and I could see results after using your Pore Release three times, especially around the corners of my nose, which has been impossible to clear out before. Yes, I am on to this! I needed this forty years ago. Thank you for creating this while I can still benefit from it.
I love this product! It's really helped my skin. It's also gentle and doesn't irritate or dry out my skin. Definitely recommend and have already repurchased!

This product did a good job with clearing up acne without being too overly drying for my skin. I did not notice much of a difference with its ability to clear up blackheads however. Made my skin feel fresh and smoother/less irritated and bumpy with only one use. If you are looking for a pore cleaning and minimizing product this is excellent.
I use this every night after and I have definitely seen a different in my skin. I have sensitive acne prone skin and it's helped with breakouts.
Gentle and not irritating, however stubborn chin blackheads have not gotten better with continuous use.
Great stuff to will purchase more! Dies what it is made for!!!!!
With consistent use it has reduced my blackheads. Makes skin look clearer and clears up congestion.
This is a perfect toner and my face looks so much better. Thank you.

I'm so I glad I tried this toner. My skin hasn't been this clear in years. Makes my skin immediately super smooth and glowy. I have very sensitive skin and have been using tretinoin. This toner has not given me any irritation.
So far so good…not five stars yet bc I just started using it. :+1::skin-tone-3:

This is the only toner that I've used that has actually unclogged my pores. I concentrate it on my nose and the areas around my nose, and then I bring it up to my forehead and down to my chin. I've seen a drastic change in how my nose pores look; they're much less clogged. My only complaint is that the bottle doesn't last very long for the price of it. I'm about a month in and almost out already. I only use it once a day at night.

I have a been using this product for about 2 months now and I can't believe how much it's helped my skin has looked so much better it dose not burn when I put it on like others I have tried I would definitely recommend if you have a problem with black heads
I use this all the time really helps my black heads and it dose NOT burn

I use this product ALL the time and its the first one of its kind I have found to not make my sensitive skin red and irritated! Normally products like this will make my skin breakout even more but this has helped clear up my skin so much.

I like the way my skin feels so clean. I get whiteheads. This toner cleans before and after poking with a needle and gently removing them with thin tweezers. Overall, my skin is looking a bit brighter. I need to find something to lighten she spots.
Gets rid of blackheads and all blemishes really and is easy to use. No burn and no discomfort as well

I've used this product for a while and have noticed it has reduced my whiteheads a bit, but i have not noticed a difference in my blackheads. i still like the product but i am not sure if i would repurchase it, simply because my blackheads haven't changed.
I love this product because I struggle to minimize my pores. You can use a small amount to achieve the solution you want and the size of the bottle is nice too.
Love this product! It definitely has been helping with my blackhead and white heads. I had a really bad breakout on my chin and since using this it's cleared up. My skin feels smooth and is glowing.

avis.titre: Good but nothing special. Can find cheaper alternative
avis.texte: I recommend this but so far, I don't see anything special about it to differentiate it from other products, such as the Peach Slices' exfoliator, for example. I love the watery consistency and light weight formula. It also doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, so I recommend it for those with sensitivity.

I like this product a lot. It's got a powerful punch of acids to help exfoliate skin but it doesn't burn to use like many products do. The formulation is very gentle and goes on very smooth. It's not super sticky or drying. It has a strong smell for me personally because I'm sensitive to smells but it's not like an overpowering punch-you-in-the-face smell of flowers or chemical fragrance. It's more mild than a lot of products. I recommend trying this product! I also really like the green pimple correct pen. Highly recommend trying.
This absolutely works. My clogging on my nose and chin has reduced significantly. Prior to this, I was using another brand which was cheaper and pretty good, but this one is just better, hanes down!
I broke out after using this for 3 days. I stopped till my acne clear. Start using it again and start to break out again. This product is not for me.
So far it's cleaning up my pores especially my nose!!!! Recommend!!!!!

I've been using this on my nose and face for 2 weeks and can already see a huge difference in my complexion. Previously I used dermalogica but this is way more affordable and it works really well. Highly recommend
Typically a Paula's Choice BPA user, maybe once a week/as needed. I ran out and decided to try this. Love it. No irritation on my sensitive skin, not overly drying, no discernable fragrance.

So far so good! I've used Pore Release for a few weeks, and so far my skin is responding really well. I'll be excited to see how it's working after a longer time. I still have some breakouts but they've been clearing quickly.
